description: The root of the class tree and its ci branch (ADR-040 D3): what IT4IT's Actual Product Instance is made of. A field is declared as a service's field is (ADR-020 fields.json: type, required, immutable, description), plus key — the rank of the identity key it is part of (D5; fields with one rank form one key, the lowest rank is tried first) — and identifying with otel — which OpenTelemetry resource attributes name the CI (D14). volatile: the value changes by itself (a pool's used, a lease): it has history like any other, and never counts as drift. A member of an object or of an array's items marked volatile (a condition's lastChecked) is not history at all: a value that differs only there is rewritten in place. desiredRecord on a class: a config/ record can declare it, so one without is unmanaged in a sweep (D15). A class's expiry (on ci, inherited; a number and s, m, h or d) is how long a CI may go unreported before it is marked unseen (D5); it is never deleted. A field a subclass declares again with only some properties refines the inherited one (a key on name). type relation: the value is another object, kept as a row in relation, not in attribute.

object.description: Every object in the CMDB: a CI, a resource or a place.

name.description: The object's name: a module's name, an asset's tag, a port's label. Kept in object.name.

displayName.description: A label for people; the role's name on a migrated asset (O5).

placeholder.description: Set on an object made because a report named it by class and name before its owner reported it: a name and nothing else. Its owner's report merges into it and clears this.

drift.description: Set when an observation differs from the last with no change behind it (D6): since, source, the attributes with what they were and are. A change that touches the object clears it.

since.description: When the status or reason last changed.

lastChecked.description: When it was last confirmed: rewritten in place, never history.

derived.description: It follows from another object's failure (rootCause), or is a roll-up: not a failure of its own.

rootCause.description: The id of the object it follows from.

acknowledged.description: An operator's acknowledgement: it keeps its status and stops counting.

maintenance.description: A maintenance window: transitions are recorded, not counted.

flapping.description: health-manager emit's (ADR-041 D4): assess carries it over.

flappingHeld.description: health-manager emit's (ADR-041 D4): assess carries it over.

conditions.description: Its health, one per kind (ADR-041 D1), as Kubernetes gives a resource's status.conditions. health-manager assess is the only writer. Volatile: never drift. Every change but lastChecked opens a new period, so its history is the object's health history.

ci.description: A configuration item: exists because a desired record exists, and ends with it (D7).

desired.description: The desired record: config/<file>.json, and the key in it where the file holds several.

release.description: The module and version this CI is an instance of (D1).

node.description: What runs software (ArchiMate Node, ADR-022c): a module of kind vm, lxc, machine or device (ADR-022d).

zone.description: The zone it is in: the zone0 of its record (ADR-040 step 4).

maturity.description: The status of its record: Development, Testing, Production.

state.description: Whether it runs, as the cluster says: running, stopped, template.

haNode.description: The node it fails over to: the HANode of its record.

vmid.description: The Proxmox VMID: VMID + cluster, then the module name (D5).

nics.description: Its network devices, as the guest's config has them (D15).

firewall.description: The firewall VM's plane at full depth (D15): rules in live order, aliases, nat, routes, certificates, packages, dhcpRanges, dhcpHosts, interfaces, vlans.

authentik.description: The identity VM's Authentik at full depth (D15): providers, applications, outposts, flows.

machine.description: A module of kind machine: a cluster member, a satellite, a managed host (ADR-026).

network.description: `site-manager node network show`: its uplinks declared and live, LLDP, HA, corosync. An attribute, as nics[]: a port needs an asset, this does not.

name.description: The Proxmox node name within the cluster (D5).

asset.description: The box it runs on, for now (an asset allocated-to this machine).

nics.description: Every physical NIC, used or not (D15): name, MAC, kind, speed, link, bond or bridge. Volatile: its link state moves.

disks.description: Every disk (D15), when no asset holds them: by-id name, model, serial, size, type, bus, SMART health, partitions.

storages.description: Every storage the node knows (pvesm). Volatile: it carries usage.

pciDevices.description: PCI devices a guest could take (D15).

device.description: A module of kind device: reachable, not managed; also a switch or AP from the switch configuration.

deviceType.description: What the switch configuration says it is.

managed.description: How the switch is driven: auto, manual.

order.description: Its place in the switch inventory: a cable between two switches is drawn from the first.

mlag.description: Its MLAG side (peerPort, bridge) and the pair it is in (name, switches, peerPort).

lags.description: `switch-manager lag list`: its LAGs, declared and live.

uplink.description: An access point's switch and port.

ssids.description: `ap-manager list`: the SSIDs an access point carries (zone, vlan, security, disabled).

controller.description: The controller that manages it, if one.

vlans.description: Every VLAN it has, each marked declared in zones.json or not (D15).

clients.description: An AP's clients: MAC, SSID, signal (D15).

software.description: What runs in a node: known by its name within its node (D5).

version.description: Not a key: its history is the upgrades (D5).

app.description: An application with a version: pve on tappaas1, authentik in identity; a module of kind application.

moduleNode.description: The node its record names; none where onNode is only where it was put.

controller.description: A controller of the control plane (ADR-007f).

manager.description: A manager of the control plane (ADR-007f).

network-element.description: What the network is made of.

state.description: active, inactive, mandatory, …, as zones.json has it.

interface.description: The firewall interface that carries it (D15): identifier, device, tag, ipv4, enabled.

address.description: An IP address, leased or reserved.

reservation.description: The MAC it is reserved for.

certificate-authority.description: One of the site's CAs (ADR-043 D11): the internal CA, or a CA for a domain tree. Its fingerprint is part of its key, so a replaced CA is a new CI and its history stays with the old one.

permitted.description: The names its constraint allows, each with its subdomains.

state.description: active, or retiring: a rotation under way, or no local environment left.

escrowed.description: When its key last reached the USB stick; empty when never.

certificates.description: What it has issued: name, names, notAfter, and the refid of one the firewall serves.

onNode.description: The mothership, which holds its key.

storage-pool.description: A pool on a node: ZFS pool names repeat across the nodes, so its key is its name on its node.

zfsState.description: ZFS's word for it: ONLINE, DEGRADED, FAULTED, … health-manager assess makes it a condition.

vdevs.description: Its layout (D15): vdevs with state, members by device, serial and state; volatile, a member's state moves. Its members that a disk asset records are its built-on disks.

size.description: Its filesystem's: moves with what shares the disk.

restorePoints.description: Per group: ns, type, id, snapshots, newest, ageSeconds (D15).

syncJobs.description: Its sync jobs with their last run (D15).

backup-peer.description: A buddy site we back up to or receive from.

role.description: As backup-manager peers says it: pull, remote, receive.

tunnel.description: <serve|dial> <net/30>[ :port] when the pull runs over a buddy tunnel.

direction.description: pull: we pull from it; receive: it pushes to us; pulled-by: it pulls ours.

publicIp.description: site.json network.publicIp: an address, or auto.

version.description: The TAPPaaS release: the control plane's own build, which a refresh or an update moves on purpose. Volatile: its history is kept, a new build is never drift.

rootCauses.description: The current root causes, most impact first (ADR-041 D3): the object, the condition type, how many objects it explains. Written by health-manager assess.

assessment.description: The last health-manager assess: when, and each gate's line as validate prints it. Rewritten in place, never history.

corosyncLinks.description: The corosync links and their state (D15).
